heroIntroHtml: From the 19th-century storefronts around McKinney’s historic courthouse square to the newer homes in Stonebridge Ranch and Craig Ranch, McKinney is a city where old and new sit side by side — and each comes with different HVAC challenges, from retrofitted ductwork in century-old homes to properly sizing systems in new construction. Air Zone Experts has served McKinney for more than 20 years as a family-owned, veteran-owned company, with transparent pricing and NATE-certified technicians who get both right.

items.q: What kind of HVAC work can you do in McKinney?
items.a: We handle the full range in McKinney: air conditioning repair and replacement, air duct repair and replacement, heating service (furnace repair, heater replacement, heater installation), and 24/7 emergency response.

items.q: Does Air Zone Experts handle emergencies any time of day in McKinney?
How do you determine pricing for jobs in McKinney?
items.a: We inspect first, quote second, repair third, always in that order. No surprises, no pressure — the number holds regardless of how the job goes.

items.q: How can I verify an HVAC contractor is insured in McKinney?
items.a: Ask the contractor directly for a certificate of insurance, or check their license status at tdlr.texas.gov, since Texas requires insurance as part of ACR licensing. Air Zone Experts is fully insured and happy to provide proof on request, and owner Adrian Racovei also holds NATE and EPA Section 608 certifications.

items.q: Is Air Zone Experts a trusted HVAC company in McKinney?
items.a: Family-owned and veteran-owned since 2008 — the same years McKinney spent growing from the Collin County seat into one of the largest cities in North Texas.

items.q: What do other customers say about Air Zone Experts in McKinney?
items.a: We’re proud to say yes — family-owned and veteran-owned, which shows up in more than 400 five-star reviews and an 85% referral rate.

items.q: Can you service HVAC systems in the older homes near McKinney's historic downtown square?
items.a: Yes. Homes near McKinney’s historic square, some dating back to the late 1800s, often have retrofitted ductwork and tighter mechanical spaces — our technicians are experienced working around both.

items.q: How regularly does my system need servicing in McKinney?
items.a: Biannual maintenance is what we suggest — a spring tune-up before cooling season and a fall check before heating season.

items.q: Can most HVAC repairs be completed same-day in McKinney?
items.a: Yes, in most situations — a single visit typically resolves the issue within a few hours. If a specific part needs to be ordered, we’ll let you know upfront and get it resolved as fast as possible.

items.q: Do you install and service systems in newer McKinney neighborhoods like Stonebridge Ranch and Craig Ranch?
items.a: Absolutely. New-construction systems in Stonebridge Ranch or Craig Ranch get the same attention as a decades-old system near downtown — we size and service both correctly.

items.q: How soon can I get HVAC service in McKinney?
items.a: Most of the time, yes. Call as early in the day as you can, and we’ll work to restore your comfort before nightfall.

items.q: Which HVAC brands do contractors install in McKinney?
items.a: Trane authorization means factory training on their equipment, but we install and service all major brands, sized correctly for the North Texas climate.
